2609.28963.title: Back to the Definition: Estimating Step-Level Advantages via Trajectory Graphs for Agentic Reinforcement Learning
2609.28963.paper_summary: Group-based reinforcement learning (RL) methods, such as GRPO and its variants, have become a leading paradigm for training reasoning and agentic large language models (LLMs). While their group-normalized advantage estimation is reliable at the response level, it becomes systematically biased at the step level, since coarse-grained trajectory-level advantages are hard to accurately reflect the contribution of individual steps (i.e, failed trajectories may contain valuable steps). Revisiting the foundational RL definition, we notice that GRPO's success on single-turn tasks stems from its advantage estimation strategy, which adheres to the basic definition: the mean reward of multiple actions sampled from the same state constitutes a credible state-value estimate. Extending the faithful estimation to step-level would in principle demand sampling multiple actions from each intermediate state, which is too costly on a per-state basis. To mitigate this issue, we propose a Graph-based Faithful sTep-level credit-assignment framework (GRAFT) that grafts all rollout trajectories into a trajectory graph, recovering node state-values via Bellman iteration on the graph, and assigning credit to each edge by the node value difference. Theoretically, the estimated step-level advantage faithfully adheres to the basic advantage definition in RL. To further ensure the reliability of step-level advantage estimation, we further propose Graph GAE, which extends GAE to the trajectory graph for reducing the impact of state-value estimation bias. Experiments across a range of multi-turn agentic benchmarks show consistent gains over GRPO and superior performance compared to recent agentic RL algorithms. Code will be available at https://github.com/xcyao00/GRAFT.
2609.28963.paper_summary_zh: 群體基礎的強化學習（RL）方法，如 GRPO 及其變體，已成為訓練推理和代理大型語言模型（LLMs）的主要範式。雖然它們的群體正規化優勢估計在回應層面上是可靠的，但在步驟層面上卻系統性地存在偏差，因為粗粒度的軌跡級優勢難以準確反映個別步驟的貢獻（即失敗的軌跡可能包含有價值的步驟）。重新審視基礎的 RL 定義，我們注意到 GRPO 在單回合任務上的成功源於其優勢估計策略，該策略遵循基本定義：從同一狀態抽樣的多個動作的平均獎勵構成可信的狀態價值估計。將忠實的估計擴展到步驟層面原則上需要從每個中間狀態抽樣多個動作，這在每個狀態的基礎上成本過高。為了緩解這一問題，我們提出了一種基於圖的忠實步驟級信用分配框架（GRAFT），將所有回合軌跡 graft 進一個軌跡圖，通過在圖上進行 Bellman 迭代來恢復節點狀態值，並根據節點值差異為每條邊分配信用。理論上，估計的步驟級優勢忠實地遵循 RL 中的基本優勢定義。為了進一步確保步驟級優勢估計的可靠性，我們進一步提出了 Graph GAE，將 GAE 擴展到軌跡圖，以減少狀態價值估計偏差的影響。在一系列多回合代理基準測試中的實驗顯示，相較於 GRPO，具有一致的增益，並且與近期的代理 RL 算法相比表現優越。代碼將在 https://github.com/xcyao00/GRAFT 提供。
